_readme: 1.7.3 What's New — REWRITTEN 2026-09-09 for the build-125 cut. The earlier draft in this file described the 09-04 scope (palette, guest button, club finder) and was written before the Ball IQ card rebuild, the History replay and the sim sweep; those are the headline now and the old copy undersold the release. Previous live build was 1.7.2 (iOS 111 / Play vc47), so everything since 09-01 is in this note. ASC takes all 15 locales; Play takes 11 as <locale>…</locale> blocks — map de-DE←de, es-419←es-MX, fr-FR←fr, it-IT←it, tr-TR←tr. ⚠️ PLAY CAPS RELEASE NOTES AT 500 CHARS PER LOCALE (ASC allows 4000): de, es-ES, es-MX, fr, fr-CA and pt-PT were 503-525 and were trimmed to fit BOTH stores with one text per language. Check every locale against 500 before shipping, not just English.

whatsNew.en-GB:
Your Ball IQ card is rebuilt. Every answer counts toward it now, and harder questions count for more — medium 10% more, hard 20%. Ratings were recalibrated once, so your number may have moved.

Yesterday's puzzles are playable from History: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail and Mystery Player.

A fresh look, a club finder on Home, and your results stay on screen with a one-tap reminder for tomorrow.

Plus a long list of fixes.

whatsNew.es-ES:
Tu tarjeta Ball IQ se ha reconstruido. Ahora cuenta cada respuesta, y las preguntas difíciles cuentan más: las medias un 10 % más y las difíciles un 20 %. Las valoraciones se recalibraron una vez, así que tu número puede haber cambiado.

Los retos de ayer se pueden jugar desde el Historial: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail y Mystery Player.

Seu cartão Ball IQ foi reconstruído. Agora toda resposta conta, e as perguntas difíceis contam mais: médias 10% a mais e difíceis 20%. As notas foram recalibradas uma vez, então seu número pode ter mudado.

Os desafios de ontem podem ser jogados pelo Histórico: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail e Mystery Player.

Visual renovado, busca de clubes na tela inicial e seus resultados ficam na tela com um lembrete para amanhã em um toque.

Além de uma longa lista de correções.

O teu cartão Ball IQ foi reconstruído. Agora todas as respostas contam, e as perguntas difíceis contam mais: médias mais 10% e difíceis mais 20%. As classificações foram recalibradas uma vez, por isso o teu número pode ter mudado.

Os desafios de ontem podem ser jogados a partir do Histórico: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail e Mystery Player.

E ainda muitas correções.
whatsNew.tr:
Ball IQ kartın yeniden yapıldı. Artık her cevap sayılıyor ve zor sorular daha çok değerli: orta %10, zor %20 daha fazla. Puanlar bir kez yeniden ayarlandı, bu yüzden sayın değişmiş olabilir.

Dünkü bulmacalar Geçmiş'ten oynanabiliyor: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail ve Mystery Player.

Yeni bir görünüm, Ana Sayfa'da kulüp arama ve sonuçların ekranda kalıyor; yarın için tek dokunuşla hatırlatma.

Ayrıca uzun bir düzeltme listesi.
whatsNew.fr:
Votre carte Ball IQ est reconstruite. Chaque réponse compte désormais, et les questions difficiles comptent davantage : moyennes +10 %, difficiles +20 %. Les notes ont été recalibrées une fois, votre chiffre a donc pu changer.

Les jeux d'hier sont jouables depuis l'Historique : Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail et Mystery Player.

Un nouveau look, une recherche de clubs sur l'accueil, et vos résultats restent à l'écran avec un rappel pour demain.

Et de nombreux correctifs.

whatsNew.de:
Deine Ball-IQ-Karte wurde neu gebaut. Jetzt zählt jede Antwort, und schwerere Fragen zählen mehr: mittel 10 % mehr, schwer 20 %. Die Bewertungen wurden einmalig neu kalibriert, deine Zahl kann sich verschoben haben.

Die Rätsel von gestern lassen sich im Verlauf spielen: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail und Mystery Player.

Ein frischer Look, eine Vereinssuche auf der Startseite, und deine Ergebnisse bleiben auf dem Bildschirm – mit einer Erinnerung für morgen.

Dazu viele Korrekturen.
whatsNew.it:
La tua card Ball IQ è stata ricostruita. Ora conta ogni risposta, e le domande difficili contano di più: medie +10%, difficili +20%. I punteggi sono stati ricalibrati una volta, quindi il tuo numero potrebbe essere cambiato.

I giochi di ieri si possono giocare dalla Cronologia: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail e Mystery Player.

Un nuovo look, un cerca-club nella Home e i tuoi risultati restano sullo schermo, con un promemoria per domani in un tocco.

Più un lungo elenco di correzioni.
whatsNew.id:
Kartu Ball IQ kamu dibangun ulang. Kini setiap jawaban dihitung, dan soal yang lebih sulit bernilai lebih: sedang 10% lebih, sulit 20%. Peringkat dikalibrasi ulang sekali, jadi angkamu mungkin berubah.

Teka-teki kemarin bisa dimainkan dari Riwayat: Footle, Daily 7, Transfer Trail, dan Mystery Player.

Tampilan baru, pencarian klub di Beranda, dan hasilmu tetap di layar dengan pengingat untuk besok dalam satu ketukan.

Plus daftar panjang perbaikan.
whatsNew.ar:
أُعيد بناء بطاقة Ball IQ الخاصة بك. أصبحت كل إجابة تُحتسب الآن، والأسئلة الأصعب تُحتسب أكثر: المتوسطة بزيادة 10% والصعبة 20%. أُعيدت معايرة التقييمات مرة واحدة، لذا قد يكون رقمك قد تغيّر.

يمكن لعب ألغاز الأمس من السجل: Footle وDaily 7 وTransfer Trail وMystery Player.

مظهر جديد، وبحث عن ناديك في الصفحة الرئيسية، ونتائجك تبقى على الشاشة مع تذكير للغد بلمسة واحدة.

بالإضافة إلى قائمة طويلة من الإصلاحات.
